title: Karenggapa - Wikipedia
text: The Karenggapa are an Aboriginal Australian people of New South Wales. Norman Tindale estimated the extent of their tribal lands at 14,000 square kilometres (5,500 mi 2), reaching from Mount Bygrave in northwestern New South Wales to Woodbum Lake in Queensland.
